products.title: Oteco Model 6 Pressure Gauge, Standard Service
products.descriptionShort: Oteco Model 6 drilling pressure gauges, standard trim: 4-7/8 in dial case, ranges to 20,000 psi, psi, bar, kPa and kg/cm² dials, threaded, flanged and hammer-union subs — 118 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
The Oteco Model 6 is a heavy-duty drilling and production pressure gauge for standpipe, mud pump, choke and kill, cementing and well-testing lines. Its dial case is 4-7/8 in across and it stands about 9-7/8 in tall on the standard threaded sub; ranges run to 20,000 psi. This listing covers the standard service gauges — 118 part numbers, each a combination of dial range and unit (psi, bar, kPa or kg/cm²), standard or luminous dial face, and end connection.

Oteco states that the Model 6 is interchangeable with the Cameron Type F, Totco Type 6, Geosource Type F, Wadeco Model 10 and Gauges International Model 6 gauges.

How the gauge is built

  • A built-in dampener protects the movement from pump pulsation and mechanical shock.
  • Heavy-duty seals keep line fluid out of the mechanism, which runs in a special oil for temperature, vibration and shock resistance.
  • A low-pressure plug on the back protects the case and lens.
  • Subs are threaded (standard: 2" line pipe thread male with 1" line pipe thread female), API flanged — with stainless or Inconel-inlaid ring grooves on request — or hammer-union, made to mate with FMC Weco Figure 1502, 2002 and 2202 unions.
  • Trims for standard mud, salt water and sour gas; this listing is the standard trim.

Rating

The maximum pressure of a gauge is the lower of its dial range and the rating of its sub end connection — a 2-inch line-pipe sub is limited to 6,000 or 10,000 psi depending on the sub. Operating temperature is −20 °F to 180 °F. ABS and DNV unit certification is available on request.

Rebuilding

Oteco rebuilds and refurbishes its gauges and most Cameron-style gauges to like-new condition; we arrange the exchange.
